wiki.title: Brad Hudson
wiki.extract: Brad Hudson is an American politician serving as a member of the Missouri Senate for the 33rd district, representing much of southern Missouri. Brad previously served as a member of the Missouri House of Representatives from the 138th district from 2019 to 2025.
